channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: 33rd Annual Chamber Golf Tournament (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Friday 10/2 · Registration 8:00 AM · Shotgun start 9:00 AM | Stonebrook Golf Club | from $120. The Santa Rosa County Chamber of Commerce runs its 33rd golf tournament at Stonebrook Golf Club in Pace. It's billed as the Team Bruce Baker, MBA-REMAX Select Partners Golf Classic. Registration and breakfast pastries start at 8 AM, with a 9 AM shotgun start and lunch and awards after. Single golfers, four-person teams and tee sign sponsorships are all sold separately on the chamber's site.

item.title: Ballet Pensacola: Frankenstein (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Fri 10/2 7 PM · Sat 10/3 1:30 PM and 7 PM · Sun 10/4 1:30 PM | Ballet Pensacola, The Center | No published price. A gothic, atmospheric Frankenstein ballet plays one October weekend, October 2-4, a moody, elegant date. Bonus for a young dance fan: a matinee could work too.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Thursday 10/1 | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: HUNKS THE SHOW at Wind Creek Atmore (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Fri 10/2 · 8:00 PM and Sat 10/3 · 7:00 PM | Coosawada Ballroom, Wind Creek Atmore | No published price. HUNKS THE SHOW plays the Coosawada Ballroom at Wind Creek Atmore, Friday at 8 PM and Saturday at 7 PM. Wind Creek bills it as adult-oriented programming, but no age minimum is published, so confirm before buying tickets.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Tuesday 9/15 | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts this youth exhibition tied to the Jazz Art Writers South Festival, a partnership between Mobile Arts Council and Amp Up Arts. More than 50 paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 line the space, each interpreting jazz through color and line. No viewing hours are published for Tuesday, September 15, so call the library to confirm.

item.title: Karaoke & DJ Nights: FUBAR Pizza Bar (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Nightly · 9 PM-1 AM | FUBAR Pizza Bar | Free. Late-night karaoke runs five nights a week (Sun, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat) plus a DJ on Monday and Thursday, 9 PM to 1 AM every night, with pizza till close. It is in Fort Walton Beach.

item.title: Karaoke Block: The Block (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Wed-Sat · from 6 PM (Thu 8 PM) | The Block | Free. The Sports & Karaoke room at The Block runs Wednesday through Saturday, opening at 6 (8 on Thursday) and going late. It is downtown Fort Walton Beach.

item.title: Live Music: Manci's Antique Club (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Thu 6:30 PM · Fri-Sat 7:30 PM · Sun 6:00 PM | Manci's Antique Club | Free. This Daphne institution has walls of Jim Beam decanters and live local bands Thursday through Sunday. It is a grown-up night out.

item.title: Live Music: Paradise Bar & Grill (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Tue/Fri/Sat 5:30 PM · Sun 2:30 PM | Paradise Bar & Grill | Free. Beachside live music plays most nights on Pensacola Beach, with rotating local acts starting at 5:30 (Sundays 2:30). Wine Down Wednesday runs $3 house and $6 premium wines all day.

item.title: Make It Last: Gallery Exhibition at UWF (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Weekdays through 11/20 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM · opening reception Thursday 10/8 · 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM | UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, Building 82, The Art Gallery | Free. Make It Last is an exhibition in The Art Gallery at the UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, curated by a UWF graduate. Six artists share the space, which includes a conversation pit in the gallery alcove and a poetry wall that visitors fill with their own work. Admission is free, and the opening reception on October 8 runs from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

item.title: Northwest Florida Fair (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Tue 9/29 – Sat 10/3 · gates 5 PM weekdays, 2 PM Saturday · building/midway close times vary by day (see steps) | Destin-FWB Rigdon Center | from $10. The Northwest Florida Fair returns to the Destin-FWB Rigdon Center for five days, with separate hours for the exhibit buildings and the midway rides. It is an educational and entertainment event serving Okaloosa, South Walton and Santa Rosa counties. Ride armbands are sold separately from gate admission, and the price steps up on Friday and Saturday.

item.title: Nuts and Butts Festival (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Friday 10/2 through Sunday 10/4 · all day | Coastal County Brewing Company | No published price. Coastal County's pork and peanut festival runs three days in the beer garden. It is all day Friday through Sunday on the brewery's own calendar. No admission is published.

item.title: Pensacola Beach Songwriters Festival (cherry-pick sets) (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Oct 1-11 · venue-by-venue schedule | 22+ venues, Pensacola Beach + downtown | Free. Ten days of acoustic storyteller rounds run, mostly free, a build-your-own date. Many venues are bars; the cleaner picks are the daytime Gulfside Pavilion sets and restaurant listening rooms (Native Café, Flounders dinner sets).

item.title: Primal Fear Haunted Attraction at OWA (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Select nights through October 31 · evenings | OWA Parks & Resort | No published price. OWA's immersive haunted attraction runs on select nights through the end of October, with dates including September 25 to 26 and October 2 to 3, 9 to 10, 16 to 17 and 19 to 31. A $7 Zombie Laser Tag add-on is available alongside the main attraction, and tickets are required.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: Weekend Live Music: Sandshaker Lounge (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Every weekend · evenings | Sandshaker Lounge | Free. The Shaker, birthplace of the Bushwacker, has live music every weekend and never a cover. It is a classic Pensacola Beach dive, about 25 minutes from the bridge.

item.title: XXX Comedy Show: A Late-Night Return to 1970s Grindhouse Comedy (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Friday 10/2 · 9:30 PM (doors 9:00 PM) | Crescent Theater | No published price. The Crescent Theater in downtown Mobile runs a strictly R-rated, late-night comedy showcase styled after 1970s grindhouse cinema. Regional comedians perform uncensored sets, and the theater bills it as unfiltered humor with no safety rails. The show is 18 and up.

item.title: First Friday Coffee, sponsored by talking Parents (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Friday 10/2 · 7:00 AM to 9:00 AM | Christian Life Center, First Baptist Church of Fort Walton Beach | No published price. The Chamber's monthly First Friday Coffee meets at the Christian Life Center inside First Baptist Church of Fort Walton Beach, sponsored this month by talking Parents. Chamber members attend as a complimentary benefit, and anyone considering membership can join for $40. Coffee and networking run from 7 AM to 9 AM; this is the October session.

item.title: The Great Bellingrath Harvest (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Daily through 11/8 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Bellingrath Gardens and Home | from $11. Bellingrath Gardens and Home runs a fall festival from September 19 through November 8 with seasonal displays across the gardens, including the scarecrow exhibit and pumpkin displays. The gardens are open daily, and the general admission price applies. The events page does not list a separate price for the harvest, so the gardens ticket is the number to plan with.

item.title: Cornhole Open Play (FRI 10/2)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members toss bags at the boards during open-play cornhole at the Niceville Senior Center. It runs casually throughout the center's regular weekday hours. City of Niceville residents play free, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Exercise Room (FRI 10/2)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. The Niceville Senior Center's exercise room stays open for members to work through strength, cardio, and flexibility routines on their own schedule. Equipment includes two recumbent bikes, a treadmill, free weights, a stability ball, mats, and stretch bands. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Putting Green Open Play (FRI 10/2)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members check out putters and balls at the front desk to practice on the Niceville Senior Center's putting green. It is casual, and you can work on your short game alone or play a round with friends. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Table Tennis Open Play (FRI 10/2)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Niceville Senior Center's table tennis room is open for casual, drop-in play with no experience required. The city describes it as an active, social way to spend the morning rather than a competitive league. It shares the Tuesday 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM window with several other open-play programs at the center, and members age 55 and up are the intended audience.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Oct 31 · 9 AM to 6 PM | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | No published price. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's own page does not print admission prices, so check the ticket page before driving out.

item.title: Ping Pong Meet-Up (FRI 10/2)
item.description: 9:30 AM to 11:00 AM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. This ping pong meetup at the Niceville Senior Center is open to beginners and experienced players alike, and the city says no experience is required to join in. It runs Wednesday mid morning and repeats on multiple weekdays.

item.title: Coco & Crawlers (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Thursday 9/17 · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Ben May Main Library, Youth Programming Room | No published price. This caregiver meetup in the Youth Programming Room at Ben May Main Library pairs children's play with a warm drink. It gives caregivers time to connect with each other. It runs Thursday morning from 10 AM to 11 AM, repeating on the third Thursday of the month, with more dates on October 15, November 19 and December 17. Registration is requested but not required.

item.title: Craft and Chat (Navarre) (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Friday 10/2 · 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM | Navarre Library | No published price. Craft and Chat is a two hour open crafting session at the Navarre Library, held on a recurring schedule through the fall.

item.title: Destin Fishing Rodeo: Daily Public Weigh-Ins (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Daily, Oct 1 – Oct 31 · 10:00 AM-7:00 PM | Docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar | Free. Anglers competing in the month-long Destin Fishing Rodeo bring their catches to the scale on the harbor docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar every day in October. The public is welcome to watch for free from 10 AM to 7 PM, and the crowd tends to grow with the size of the fish coming off the boats.

item.title: Mexican Train Dominoes (FRI 10/2)
item.description: 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Mexican Train Dominoes at the Niceville Senior Center is pitched as easy to learn, welcoming first-time players alongside the regulars. It runs Wednesday late morning into early afternoon and repeats on multiple weekdays.

item.title: Table Tennis Open Play (FRI 10/2)
item.description: 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Destin Community Center | from $2. Destin Community Center opens its tables for open table tennis play three days a week, Monday, Wednesday and Friday from 10 AM to 1 PM. Paddles and balls are provided, so nobody needs to bring their own equipment. Active Destin seniors play free, and non-residents pay $2.

item.title: Whole Wellness Yoga (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Friday 10/2 · 10 AM to 11 AM | Fort Walton Beach Library | No published price. Fort Walton Beach Library hosts a yoga class for adults in its meeting space. The library lists it as an Adults program running an hour, from 10 AM to 11 AM. No admission charge or mat rental is published on the library's own listing. Bring your own mat, since the library does not say it supplies one.

item.title: Page Turners Book Club (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Friday 10/2 · 10:30 AM to 11:30 AM | Fort Walton Beach Library: Meeting Room | No published price. Fort Walton Beach Library's Page Turners book club meets in its Meeting Room for a one-hour discussion on Friday mornings. The current listing names the August and September picks but does not identify an October title, so check with the library if you want to read ahead.

item.title: DiscipleStory (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Sundays 9/13 – 10/18 (of an 8-week class) · 11:00 AM (end time not published) | Crosspoint Niceville Campus, Room 912 | No published price. An eight-week Sunday morning class at Crosspoint's Niceville campus walks participants through identifying their own story, passions, abilities and role in the church's mission. The class starts September 13 at 11 AM; the campus newsletter does not publish an end time.

item.title: Summer's End at Quayside Art Gallery (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Daily through 10/5 · 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Quayside Art Gallery | No published price. Quayside Art Gallery in downtown Pensacola is showing Summer's End, an exhibition about the turn from late summer into autumn, through October 5. Four artists fill the show with changing landscapes, vacation memories and the amber light of late summer evenings. The gallery is a locally owned artist co-op with three floors of work by more than 50 local artists, and it opens every day from 11 AM to 5 PM.

item.title: AIA Alabama Annual Conference 2026 (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Friday 10/2 at 12:00 PM · runs through Sunday 10/4 | Perdido Beach Resort | from $35. Perdido Beach Resort hosts the AIA Alabama Annual Conference 2026 starting Friday, October 2. Architecture professionals gather for continuing education, networking, a product show, awards, and social events. Full meeting registration is $495 for AIA members and $695 for non-members, with a $50 rate for young professionals and students. A spouse or guest can attend for $75, and children are $35. The conference returns every year.

item.title: Operation Tabletop (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Friday 10/2 · 12 PM to 4 PM | Fort Walton Beach Library | No published price. Fort Walton Beach Library opens its meeting space for an afternoon of tabletop games for adults. The library lists this as an Adults program running from noon to 4 PM, with no stated theme beyond open tabletop play. No admission charge is published, and the library does not require advance sign up on its listing. It runs the same week as several other adult programs at the branch, so parking can be tight midday.

item.title: Hearts Card Game (FRI 10/2)
item.description: 1:00 PM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. The Niceville Senior Center opens its doors on Wednesday afternoons for a drop in game of Hearts, welcoming beginners and experienced players alike. No reservation is needed, so you can just show up and find a table. The center is open to members age 55 and up, and City of Niceville residents get free membership. Non-resident membership pricing isn't published, so call ahead.

item.title: Furry Friend Friday (Navarre) (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Friday 10/2 · 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM | Navarre Library | No published price. Furry Friend Friday brings a therapy animal into the Navarre Library for an hour on the date below.

item.title: Sketch Club in the Gardens (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Fridays 8/28 through 10/16 · 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM (space permitting) | Mobile Botanical Gardens | from $6. Botanical arts instructor Derek Norman leads a casual Friday sketch session in the Larkins Classroom or the Magnolia Hill Studio. Garden members get in free, everyone else pays the standard Mobile Botanical Gardens admission, and the garden's own site is not internally consistent about what the military and veteran rate actually is.

item.title: Make & Take Art: weekly drop-in art sessions (FRI 10/2)
item.description: Thursdays 8/27 through 10/15 (except Sept 8) · 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM | Mobile Museum of Art | Free. The museum runs a free Thursday afternoon art session most weeks, working through materials and techniques borrowed from artists on view. Projects range from geometric shape painting to a Basquiat-inspired dinosaur build. The printed schedule also lists a session for September 8, but that date falls on a Tuesday, not a Thursday, so check with the museum first.
